title: Environment BuildTest accepted command and output collection
alt: Environment resolves only Core's immutable accepted command and persists the stable operation with PostgreSQL-precision UTC timestamps before provider effects. It rechecks current authorization, Sandbox lease, writable Workspace PVC, and Cilium binding for each effect. A gated command Pod runs under an operation-scoped offline policy; only verified exit zero starts a separate gated collector Pod with a read-only PVC. The pinned collector returns a bounded no-follow file receipt tied to its Pod UID and the request fingerprint. Restart replay preserves terminal evidence; unknown effects reconcile the same operation, and Core retains MAF checkpoint and run-state ownership.

steps.label: The caller provides only a checkpoint reference and expected binding. Projects grants authority; Core alone owns MAF checkpoints and run state.
Verify fresh WriteProjects/ReadRunSelection authority and resolve the complete checkpoint
Return current authorization and Core's immutable command/options/hash/stable operation ID
Persist accepted intent and fingerprint with PostgreSQL-precision UTC timestamps in owner_effects
Before each effect, recheck authorization, accepted intent, current Sandbox lease, exact writable PVC, and network binding.
Create and verify command-role, operation-scoped offline deny-all policy
Bind the exact policy UID, spec hash, and generation
Persist attempt, then create the accepted command Pod behind a scheduling gate
Return exact Pod UID/resourceVersion and validated command container
Recheck bindings, then release the gate on the exact Pod
Observe exact terminal evidence and bounded command output
Required file outputs after verified command exit zero
Create a separate collector-role offline deny-all policy
Create a separate gated collector Pod with the exact Workspace PVC read-only
Read accepted paths with native no-follow flags and bounded reads on the read-only Workspace
Return bounded regular-file hashes and sizes with Pod UID, container, and request fingerprint
Persist one immutable terminal snapshot; restart replay preserves evidence, and uncertain effects reconcile the same operation
Logs are not file evidence. Missing required output is Failed; cancellation, timeout, and limits are Interrupted. Core acknowledges MAF interruption.
